post_title: H1B Transfer Application Delay from outside US
concerns_or_questions_summary: Poster was working in the U.S. on H-1B but had to return to India after a layoff. A new employer filed an H-1B transfer petition in January under premium processing, but no updates have been received. Asking for advice on possible next steps and whether others have experienced similar delays.
